notes: The CrossFit movement lexicon the compiler matches WOD prose against.
aliases are lowercase, singular, hyphens as spaces; the matcher allows plurals, hyphens and 'alternating'/'strict'/'kipping' prefixes.
catalog is the yuhonas/free-exercise-db id the movement maps to (instructions come from there); null means no equivalent in that catalog.
measure is what a line of this movement counts by default: reps, distance, calories, seconds or load.

movements.name: Air squat
movements.note: Hips below the knees at the bottom, hips fully open at the top. No weight.

movements.name: Back squat
movements.note: Bar on the back. Hips below the knees at the bottom.

movements.name: Front squat
movements.note: Bar racked on the shoulders, elbows high. Hips below the knees.

movements.name: Overhead squat
movements.note: Bar locked out overhead the whole way down and up.

movements.name: Goblet squat
movements.note: Weight held at the chest. Hips below the knees.

movements.name: Dumbbell front squat
movements.note: Dumbbells on the shoulders. Hips below the knees.

movements.name: Single-leg squat
movements.note: One leg, hip below the knee, the other leg out in front. Alternate unless told otherwise.

movements.name: Jumping squat
movements.note: Full squat, then leave the floor.

movements.name: Wall-ball shot
movements.note: Squat with the ball at the chest, stand and throw it to the target. Catch and go again.

movements.name: Thruster
movements.note: Front squat straight into a push press. One movement, no pause.

movements.name: Dumbbell thruster
movements.note: Front squat with the dumbbells, drive them overhead on the way up.

movements.name: Deadlift
movements.note: Bar from the floor to standing tall, hips and knees locked.

movements.name: Dumbbell deadlift
movements.note: Dumbbells from the floor to standing tall.

movements.name: Sumo deadlift high pull
movements.note: Wide stance, pull from the floor to under the chin, elbows high.

movements.name: Romanian deadlift
movements.note: Hinge at the hips with a soft knee, bar close to the legs.

movements.name: Clean
movements.note: Floor to the shoulders, received in a full squat.

movements.name: Power clean
movements.note: Floor to the shoulders, received above a parallel squat.

movements.name: Hang clean
movements.note: Starts from the hang, above the knee. Received in a full squat.

movements.name: Hang power clean
movements.note: From the hang to the shoulders, received above parallel.

movements.name: Clean and jerk
movements.note: Clean to the shoulders, then jerk overhead to lockout.

movements.name: Dumbbell clean
movements.note: Dumbbells to the shoulders. Squat or power as written.

movements.name: Dumbbell clean and jerk
movements.note: Dumbbell to the shoulder, then overhead.

movements.name: Medicine-ball clean
movements.note: Ball from the floor to the shoulders, received in a squat.

movements.name: Snatch
movements.note: Floor to overhead in one pull, received in a full squat.

movements.name: Power snatch
movements.note: Floor to overhead in one pull, received above parallel.

movements.name: Hang snatch
movements.note: From the hang to overhead, received in a full squat.

movements.name: Hang power snatch
movements.note: From the hang to overhead, received above parallel.

movements.name: Dumbbell snatch
movements.note: One dumbbell, floor to overhead in one pull. Alternate arms unless told otherwise.

movements.name: Kettlebell snatch
movements.note: One kettlebell, swing to overhead in one pull.

movements.name: Snatch balance
movements.note: Bar on the back, drop under it into an overhead squat.

movements.name: Snatch pull
movements.note: The pull of the snatch without going under the bar.

movements.name: Clean pull
movements.note: The pull of the clean without going under the bar.

movements.name: Shoulder press
movements.note: Shoulders to overhead with no help from the legs.

movements.name: Push press
movements.note: A dip and drive from the legs, then press to lockout.

movements.name: Push jerk
movements.note: Dip, drive, and drop under the bar to catch it locked out.

movements.name: Split jerk
movements.note: Dip, drive, and split the feet under the bar.

movements.name: Shoulder-to-overhead
movements.note: Any way from the shoulders to lockout: press, push press or jerk.

movements.name: Dumbbell shoulder-to-overhead
movements.note: Dumbbells from the shoulders to lockout, any way.

movements.name: Ground-to-overhead
movements.note: Floor to lockout overhead, any way: snatch or clean and jerk.

movements.name: Bench press
movements.note: Bar to the chest and back to lockout, lying on the bench.

movements.name: Dumbbell bench press
movements.note: Dumbbells to the chest and back to lockout.

movements.name: Floor press
movements.note: Bench press lying on the floor; elbows touch down each rep.

movements.name: Kettlebell swing
movements.note: Hinge and swing the bell to overhead. Russian swings stop at eye level.

movements.name: Russian kettlebell swing
movements.note: Hinge and swing the bell to eye level.

movements.name: Turkish get-up
movements.note: Lying to standing with the weight locked out overhead the whole way.

movements.name: Weighted dip
movements.note: Dip on the bars with added weight.

movements.name: Dumbbell row
movements.note: Bent over, pull the dumbbell to the hip.

movements.name: Bent-over row
movements.note: Bent over, pull the bar to the body.

movements.name: Good morning
movements.note: Bar on the back, hinge at the hips with a flat back.

movements.name: Pull-up
movements.note: Chin over the bar at the top, arms straight at the bottom.

movements.name: Strict pull-up
movements.note: Chin over the bar with no kip or swing.

movements.name: Chest-to-bar pull-up
aliases: strict l chest to bar pull up
movements.note: Chest touches the bar at the top.

movements.name: Weighted pull-up
movements.note: Strict pull-up with added weight.

movements.name: L pull-up
movements.note: Pull-up with the legs held straight out in front.

movements.name: Jumping pull-up
movements.note: Jump to help the chin over the bar.

movements.name: Burpee pull-up
movements.note: A burpee, then jump to the bar for a pull-up.

movements.name: Chin-up
movements.note: Pull-up with the palms facing you.

movements.name: Ring row
movements.note: Lean back under the rings and pull the chest to them.

movements.name: Push-up
movements.note: Chest to the floor, arms locked out at the top, body straight.

movements.name: Hand-release push-up
movements.note: Lift the hands off the floor at the bottom of each rep.

movements.name: Ring push-up
movements.note: Push-up with the hands on rings.

movements.name: Handstand push-up
movements.note: Upside down against the wall, head to the floor and back to lockout.

movements.name: Strict handstand push-up
aliases: chest to wall handstand push up
movements.note: Handstand push-up with no kip.

movements.name: Deficit handstand push-up
movements.note: Hands raised so the head goes below them.

movements.name: Handstand walk
movements.note: Walk on the hands for the distance.

movements.name: Handstand hold
movements.note: Hold a handstand for the time.

movements.name: Handstand shoulder tap
aliases: freestanding shoulder taps in a handstand
movements.note: In a handstand, tap one shoulder with the opposite hand.

movements.name: Wall walk
movements.note: From a push-up position, walk the feet up the wall and the hands in, then back down.

movements.name: Ring dip
movements.note: Dip on the rings, shoulders below the elbows at the bottom.

movements.name: Dip
movements.note: Dip on the bars, shoulders below the elbows at the bottom.

movements.name: Muscle-up
movements.note: Pull-up straight into a dip on the rings, to lockout.

movements.name: Strict muscle-up
movements.note: Muscle-up with no kip.

movements.name: Bar muscle-up
movements.note: Pull-up over the bar straight into a dip to lockout.

movements.name: Toes-to-bar
movements.note: Hanging from the bar, both feet touch the bar between the hands.

movements.name: Knees-to-elbows
movements.note: Hanging from the bar, both knees touch the elbows.

movements.name: Hanging knee raise
movements.note: Hanging from the bar, knees above the hips.

movements.name: Sit-up
movements.note: Shoulders touch the floor at the bottom, hands touch the feet at the top.

movements.name: GHD sit-up
movements.note: On the GHD, hands touch the floor behind, then sit up to touch the pad or the feet.

movements.name: V-up
movements.note: Lying flat, fold so the hands touch the feet above the hips.

movements.name: Back extension
movements.note: On the GHD, round down and extend the back to flat.

movements.name: Hip extension
movements.note: On the GHD, hinge at the hips with a flat back and come up to level.

movements.name: Hip and back extension
movements.note: A hip extension and a back extension in one rep.

movements.name: Glute-ham raise
movements.note: On the GHD, lower the body with the hamstrings and pull back up.

movements.name: L-sit
movements.note: Supported on the hands, legs straight out in front, hold.

movements.name: Plank hold
movements.note: Hold a straight body on the forearms or hands.

movements.name: Hollow hold
movements.note: On the back, low back pressed down, arms and legs off the floor. Hold or rock.

movements.name: Burpee
movements.note: Chest to the floor, back up, jump and clap overhead.

movements.name: Bar-facing burpee
movements.note: Burpee facing the bar, then jump over it.

movements.name: Burpee over the dumbbell
movements.note: Burpee beside the dumbbell, then jump over it.

movements.name: Burpee over the rower
movements.note: Burpee beside the rower, then step or jump over it.

movements.name: Burpee box jump
movements.note: A burpee, then jump onto the box.

movements.name: Burpee box jump-over
movements.note: A burpee, then jump onto and over the box.

movements.name: Burpee to a target
movements.note: A burpee that ends with a jump to touch the target.

movements.name: Dumbbell burpee deadlift
movements.note: A burpee with the hands on the dumbbells, then stand them up in a deadlift.

movements.name: Box jump
movements.note: Jump onto the box and stand tall on top.

movements.name: Box jump-over
movements.note: Jump onto the box and over to the other side.

movements.name: Box step-up
movements.note: Step onto the box and stand tall on top.

movements.name: Dumbbell box step-up
movements.note: Step onto the box holding the dumbbells.

movements.name: Dumbbell box step-over
movements.note: Step up onto the box and down the other side holding the dumbbells.

movements.name: Broad jump
movements.note: Two-foot jump forward for distance.

movements.name: Lunge
movements.note: Back knee touches the floor, stand tall between steps.

movements.name: Dumbbell lunge
movements.note: Lunge holding the dumbbells where the workout says.

movements.name: Barbell lunge
movements.note: Lunge with the bar on the back, the front rack or overhead.

movements.name: Double-under
movements.note: The rope passes under the feet twice per jump.

movements.name: Double-under crossover
movements.note: A double-under with the arms crossed.

movements.name: Triple-under
movements.note: The rope passes under the feet three times per jump.

movements.name: Single-under
movements.note: One pass of the rope per jump.

movements.name: Run
movements.note: Run the distance. Out and back, or on a track.

movements.name: Row
movements.note: On the rower, for the distance or the calories written.

movements.name: Bike
movements.note: On the bike, for the calories or distance written.

movements.name: Ski
movements.note: On the ski erg, for the calories or distance written.

movements.name: Swim
movements.note: Swim the distance.

movements.name: Ruck
movements.note: Walk or run the distance with the loaded pack.

movements.name: Rope climb
movements.note: Climb to the top and touch. Legs allowed unless it says legless.

movements.name: Legless rope climb
movements.note: Climb with the arms only.

movements.name: Farmers carry
movements.note: Walk the distance with a weight in each hand.

movements.name: Sandbag carry
movements.note: Carry the sandbag the distance.

movements.name: Sandbag clean
movements.note: Sandbag from the floor to the shoulder.

movements.name: Sled push
movements.note: Push the sled the distance.

movements.name: Sled pull
movements.note: Pull the sled the distance.

movements.name: Tire flip
movements.note: Flip the tire end over end.

movements.name: Bear crawl
movements.note: Crawl on hands and feet, knees off the floor.

movements.name: Pegboard ascent
movements.note: Climb the pegboard to the top.

movements.name: Single-leg skip
movements.note: Skip rope on one leg.

movements.name: Dumbbell overhead squat
movements.note: Squat with one dumbbell locked out overhead.

movements.name: Devil's press
movements.note: A burpee on the dumbbells straight into a double dumbbell snatch.

movements.name: Man-maker
movements.note: Push-up on the dumbbells, row each arm, then a clean and press.

movements.name: Renegade row
movements.note: In a push-up position on the dumbbells, row one, then the other.

movements.name: Round of Cindy
movements.note: One round is 5 pull-ups, 10 push-ups and 15 squats. Strict Cindy uses strict pull-ups.

movements.name: Skill practice
movements.note: Work on the skill at an easy pace. Not for time.

movements.name: Rest
movements.note: Rest the time written before the next part.
